question: List the names of players who were born after 1985, have a height greater than 175 cm, and achieved their highest overall rating in 2014 on or before June 30. Only include those whose peak 2014 rating was above the average overall rating of all players recorded in the first half of 2014.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE p.XCL_125 > '1985-12-31 23:59:59'
  AND p.XCL_126 > 175
  AND pa.XCL_131 <= '2014-06-30 23:59:59'
  AND pa.XCL_132 = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.XCL_132)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa2
    WHERE pa2.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
      AND pa2.XCL_131 <= '2014-06-30 23:59:59'
  )
  AND pa.XCL_132 > (
    SELECT AVG(pa3.XCL_132)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa3
    WHERE pa3.XCL_131 >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND pa3.XCL_131 <= '2014-06-30 23:59:59'
  )

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE p.XCL_125 > '1985-12-31 23:59:59'
  AND p.XCL_126 > 175
  AND pa.XCL_131 <= '2014-06-30 23:59:59'
  AND pa.XCL_132 = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.XCL_132)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa2
    WHERE pa2.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
      AND pa2.XCL_131 <= '2014-06-30 23:59:59'
  )
  AND pa.XCL_132 > (
    SELECT AVG(pa3.XCL_132)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa3
    WHERE pa3.XCL_131 >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND pa3.XCL_131 <= '2014-06-30 23:59:59'
  )

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT p.XCL_123
FROM Player p
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130
WHERE p.XCL_125 > '1985-12-31 23:59:59'
  AND pa.XCL_133 > 175
  AND pa.XCL_131 <= '2014-06-30 23:59:59'
  AND pa.XCL_132 = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.XCL_132)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa2
    WHERE pa2.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
      AND pa2.XCL_131 <= '2014-06-30 23:59:59'
  )
  AND pa.XCL_132 > (
    SELECT AVG(pa3.XCL_132)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa3
    WHERE pa3.XCL_131 <= '2014-06-30 23:59:59'
  )

JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.XCL_122 = pa.XCL_130

         OR pa2.XCL_131 LIKE '2014-04-01%'
         OR pa2.XCL_131 LIKE '2014-05-01%'
         OR pa2.XCL_131 LIKE '2014-06-01%'
